# Welcome!

Hi! My name is Jinghao Zhang.

I am currently pursuing a Master of Public Health in Biostatistics at Columbia University's Mailman School of Public Health, with an expected graduation date of May 2027.

I previously studied Applied Mathematics and Computer Science at Duke Kunshan University and Duke University.

My interests include biostatistics, data analysis, and public health research.
